newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania police recover priceless art, Hoxha gun.
newsitem.headline: Albania police recover priceless art, Hoxha gun.

text.p: Albanian police on Monday recovered a priceless 13th century canvas and a revolver belonging to late communist dictator Enver Hoxha stolen from the country's national museum two years ago.
Police found the articles while searching the house of suspect Aleksander Sota following a tipoff on Sunday, Albanian news agency ATA quoted the interior ministry as saying.
A pen and ink-well belonging to Albanian renaissance poet Ando Zako Cajupi, and four religious paintings were also recovered, the ministry said.
Albania's National Museum had been particularly concerned about the whereabouts of the embroidered canvas, known as the Gllavenica epitaph, which it considers central to Albania's heritage.
